# 1club Help

> Help center and developer documentation for 1club, AI-native management software for gyms, fitness studios, martial arts schools, and tennis, padel, and pickleball clubs. Guides for admins and staff, the 1club Platform API reference, and the 1club MCP servers for AI assistants.

This file lists the most important pages. The full text of every page, including every API endpoint, is in [llms-full.txt](https://docs.1club.ai/llms-full.txt). Each link below points to the page as Markdown.

## Get started

- [Welcome to 1club](https://docs.1club.ai/index.md): Set up your account, tour the interface, and learn the main sections of the 1club admin
- [Quickstart](https://docs.1club.ai/quickstart.md): Get your 1club admin up and running in a few steps
- [Signing in](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/sign-in.md): Sign in to 1club with Google, Apple, Facebook, or email and password, across the admin dashboard, member portal, 1club network, club website

## Admin guides

How admins and staff run a gym day to day in the 1club admin, by section.

- [Home overview](https://docs.1club.ai/home/overview.md): The first page you see in the admin - today's classes, bookings, and memberships, the Overview charts, your own earnings if you teach
- [Business audit](https://docs.1club.ai/home/ai-visibility-report.md): Generate an AI visibility report that scores your gym's online presence
- [Members overview](https://docs.1club.ai/members/overview.md): How contacts, members, leads, accounts, and cards fit together in 1club, and which pages make up the Members section of the admin
- [Member list](https://docs.1club.ai/members/member-list.md): The contacts grid under Members for finding, filtering, and bulk-acting on members, drop-ins, leads, and lapsed contacts
- [Member profile](https://docs.1club.ai/members/member-profiles.md): The per-contact page that pulls together a member's identity, balances, pipeline stage, memberships, bookings, check-ins, charges, documents, notes
- [Leads and pipeline](https://docs.1club.ai/members/leads.md): Work your sales pipeline on the Leads tab of Members
- [Accounts](https://docs.1club.ai/members/accounts.md): Group members into households or companies for shared billing, cross-member bookings, and consolidated reporting at /members/accounts
- [Member authentication](https://docs.1club.ai/members/member-authentication.md): How members sign in - the identifier your gym chooses, social sign-in, one-time phone codes, passwords, verification, invitations
- [Member onboarding](https://docs.1club.ai/members/onboarding.md): How a new person becomes a member - the signup wizard, required fields, family members, verification, and guest bookings
- [Schedule overview](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/overview.md): The Schedule section: the day and week calendar, plus the Bookings, Classes, Attendance, and Check-ins lists your front desk runs the day from
- [Calendar](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/calendar.md): The unified day/week calendar that drives bookings, classes, instructor time off, and check-in
- [Bookings](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/bookings.md): Create, edit, cancel, and take payment on reservations for areas, classes, and instructors
- [Players and group sessions](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/players-and-groups.md): Put more than one person on a single booking - the players who share an area, or a group who book one session with a coach - and how each of them pays, checks in, and leaves.
- [Classes](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/classes.md): Create one-off or recurring classes, assign instructors, manage capacity, and run check-in and waitlists
- [Attendance](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/attendance.md): Record and review member check-ins in 1club
- [Waitlists](https://docs.1club.ai/schedule/waitlists.md): Let members join a waitlist when a class is full, then automatically notify and book the next person in line when a spot opens up
- [Inbox overview](https://docs.1club.ai/inbox/overview.md): A unified inbox for outbound and inbound conversations with members, leads, and staff
- [Compose](https://docs.1club.ai/inbox/compose.md): Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp to one contact, a hand-picked list, or everyone matching a segment
- [Point of sale](https://docs.1club.ai/pos/point-of-sale.md): Ring up memberships, passes, bookings, packages, and retail products in person at the front desk, take payment, apply promotions, and check members in
- [Sales overview](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/overview.md): How the Sales section is organized - Plans, Products, Promotions, Memberships, Orders, Finance, and Cash - and how plans, orders, charges, invoices
- [Plans](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/plans.md): Membership and pass templates in 1club - price, billing frequency, usage limits, what they grant access to, signup fees, wallet credit, visibility
- [Products](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/products.md): Build your catalog of sellable items - retail, add-ons, and rentals - with categories, brands, price, revenue account, visibility
- [Promotions](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/promotions.md): Create vouchers and discounts with schedules, codes, audience targeting, and usage caps
- [Memberships](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/memberships.md): The org-wide membership grid. Sell, pause, resume, renew, and cancel memberships, and track how members consume their usage allowance
- [Charges](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/charges.md): What each payer owes for every booking, membership, signup fee, and product sale, and how charges relate to payments and invoices
- [Membership billing](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/membership-billing.md): How 1club charges membership renewals - by saved card or payment link - the billing day that puts every membership on the same day of the month, the Membership billing tab that lists every renewal charge coming up, and what happens when a renewal fails.
- [Statements](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/statements.md): Monthly statements of what a member or household was charged and paid - download or email one from the member page, print a whole month's statements at once from Sales > Finance > Statements, and let members download their own from their account.
- [Payments](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/payments.md): Track, record, and refund payments in 1club
- [Invoices](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/invoices.md): Create, send, download, and settle invoice documents that group a contact's outstanding charges under one number, due date, and PDF
- [Wallet](https://docs.1club.ai/sales/wallet.md): A per-member store-credit balance in your gym's currency that fills from vouchers, plan bonuses, refunds, and imports
- [Events overview](https://docs.1club.ai/events/overview.md): The Events section: bookable events, plus tournaments, matches, and ratings when competitions are on
- [Events](https://docs.1club.ai/events/events.md): Create one-off ticketed events, draft them with AI, sell tickets online or at the front desk, take pay-on-arrival reservations
- [Tournaments](https://docs.1club.ai/events/tournaments.md): Run a knockout or round-robin draw on an event: build the entry list from registrations, seed players, generate the draw
- [Marketing overview](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/overview.md): The Marketing section - website, automations, content, media, forms, reviews, and network listing - and how the tools fit together
- [Website builder](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/website.md): Design, translate, and publish your gym's public site from inside the admin
- [Website design](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/website-design.md): Shape how your gym's website looks - a template's look, colors, fonts, corners, spacing and motion in the Design panel, and each section's layout, background and visibility on its Design tab.
- [Automations](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/automations.md): Build event-driven workflows that message members, manage tags, and notify staff automatically - with built-in reminders and one-click blueprints
- [Forms](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/forms.md): The form builder under Marketing > Forms
- [Reviews](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/reviews.md): See member and Google reviews in one list with your coaching, facilities, and response-rate scores, report reviews that break policy
- [Network listing](https://docs.1club.ai/marketing/marketplace.md): List your gym on the 1club network so new members can discover, explore, and book it on 1club.me and in the 1club App
- [Staff overview](https://docs.1club.ai/staff/overview.md): The Staff section: your team's admin logins, instructors, pay rate policies, time off, and the shift roster
- [Instructors](https://docs.1club.ai/staff/instructors.md): Manage your coaching staff, their bookable rates, sports, types, and operating hours
- [Pay rates](https://docs.1club.ai/staff/pay-rates.md): Set what instructors earn for classes and one-on-one sessions with pay rate policies: flat fees, per-person fees, or a share of revenue
- [Analytics overview](https://docs.1club.ai/analytics/overview.md): Pre-built reports for your gyms, members, check-ins, bookings, classes, instructors, finance, revenue, sales, marketing, web traffic, and inventory - how the categories, filters, comparisons, and exports work, and who can see what.
- [Engagement analytics](https://docs.1club.ai/analytics/engagement.md): Member engagement scores (0-100) - how they are calculated, how they are read from visits (frequency, trend and recency), the dashboard, and using scores for churn-risk and win-back.
- [Occupancy](https://docs.1club.ai/analytics/occupancy.md): The Occupancy report under Analytics > Bookings - how much of the open hours of your areas, coaches, and classes was booked, an hour-by-weekday grid for every area, revenue per hour, and the hours that sit empty.
- [Finance analytics](https://docs.1club.ai/analytics/finance.md): The Finance analytics category - every charge in a period on Activity, who owes you and for how long on Amount Due, and the figures for your sales tax or VAT return on Tax.
- [Analytics definitions](https://docs.1club.ai/analytics/definitions.md): What each number on the analytics reports counts (revenue, bookings, occupancy, members, leads, email) and the reports where it appears

## Concepts and troubleshooting

- [Organizations and clubs](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/organization-clubs.md): How 1club's multi-tenant model works - organizations as the top-level tenant, clubs as locations, org and club switching
- [Roles and permissions](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/roles-permissions.md): How 1club authorizes admin users - the five built-in roles, the permission model (module, action, scope), what every permission allows
- [Check-in models](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/check-in-models.md): Choose how members enter your gym - book and pay in advance, walk in with a payment check
- [Repeating schedules](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/repeating-schedules.md): How a repeating class, booking, or instructor rotation is created
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/troubleshooting.md): Common issues you might hit using the 1club admin

## Settings

- [Settings overview](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/overview.md): Orient yourself across the 1club Settings area
- [Organization](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/organization.md): Configure organization-wide identity, address, time zone, locales, clubs, branding, and custom domains in 1club Settings
- [Platform subscription](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/platform-subscription.md): Manage your organization's own 1club (SaaS) subscription
- [Users](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/admin-users.md): Invite admin staff, assign one of five roles, reset passwords, and manage invitations from Settings > Organization > Users
- [API tokens](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/api-tokens.md): Create, scope, edit, and revoke API tokens for programmatic integrations, from Settings > Organization > APIs & webhooks
- [Areas](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/areas.md): Configure the physical spaces members book
- [Booking policies](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/booking-policies.md): Configure how members book, when they pay, and how check-in is enforced, under Settings > Bookings > Booking and cancellation policies
- [Documents and waivers](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/waivers.md): Define signable documents (liability waivers, terms, policies) under Settings > Bookings > Waivers
- [Templates](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/templates.md): Reusable message content in 1club - custom templates for manual sends, plus the system template catalog you can customize for booking, membership
- [Billing general settings](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/billing-general.md): Set your currency and tax display, and manage tax rates, revenue accounts, payment methods, deposit rules, and the companies you invoice through
- [Payment methods](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/payment-methods.md): Configure which payment methods your organization accepts at checkout and in the member portal, and which one is preselected for member bookings
- [Pricing rules](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/pricing-rules.md): Configure dynamic pricing for bookings - publish an hourly rate per time band, layer peak surcharges and off-peak discounts
- [Membership policies](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/membership-policies.md): Decide how members cancel and pause their own memberships - notice periods, early cancellation charges before a minimum term, and pause limits - under Settings > Billing > Membership Policies
- [Member portal](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/member-portal.md): Configure the member-facing portal under Settings > Member Apps > Member Portal
- [Mobile app](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/mobile-app.md): What your members do in the 1club App, how they find and join your gym, pay by card and get push notifications, and where to get the QR code and store links to share it.
- [Check-in App and kiosk](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/kiosk.md): Set up the self-service Check-in App on a tablet at your gym's door, where members check themselves in by name, QR code or PIN, and the kiosk for check-in plus browsing and booking classes, areas and plans.
- [Access control](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/access-control.md): How members identify themselves at your door (QR, access card, PIN) per club
- [Integrations](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/integrations.md): Activate and configure payment providers, door access, marketing tools, and other integrations from Settings > Integrations
- [Stripe](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/integrations/stripe.md): Accept card and digital wallet payments through Stripe, starting in a test sandbox and going live with your own Stripe Connect account
- [Data import](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/import.md): Import members, memberships, plans, classes, bookings, invoices, and charges from CSV under Settings > Data Tools > Import
- [Export](https://docs.1club.ai/settings/export.md): Download your organization data as CSV, or prep your books for QuickBooks Online

## AI assistants and MCP

Connect AI assistants to a 1club organization through the 1club MCP servers.

- [1club MCP server overview](https://docs.1club.ai/mcp/overview.md): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants to 1club through the Model Context Protocol
- [Connect an AI assistant to 1club](https://docs.1club.ai/mcp/connect.md): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or another remote MCP client to 1club with OAuth, and keep an existing API-key connection working
- [1club MCP tools reference](https://docs.1club.ai/mcp/tools.md): Every tool the 1club admin and discovery MCP servers expose, what it returns, and the OAuth scope each one requires
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://docs.1club.ai/mcp/troubleshooting.md): Fix common OAuth, scope, tool-list, and connection problems when using the 1club MCP server
- [AI assistants](https://docs.1club.ai/reference/ai-assistants.md): The AI copilot built into 1club - an admin chat assistant that books, configures, messages, and reports, plus AI reply suggestions, a day overview

## API reference

The 1club Platform API (REST, base URL `https://api.1club.ai`, paths under `/v1/platform`). Every endpoint has its own reference page, listed in llms-full.txt and the OpenAPI spec.

- [Platform API introduction](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/introduction.md): Integrate with the 1club platform to access clubs, classes, bookings, contacts, content, and transactions
- [1club network API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/marketplace-api.md): Search gyms on 1club.me, read their prices, and find bookable court times - read-only, with no API key or sign-in
- [Versioning and deprecation](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/versioning.md): How the 1club Platform API is versioned, how breaking changes ship, and how deprecated operations are marked and announced
- [API authentication](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/authentication.md): Create a scoped API key to sync bookings through the channel integration
- [Channel integration overview](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/overview.md): Sync bookings and contacts from a partner booking platform into 1club as a channel
- [Areas and availability API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/areas-and-availability.md): Discover bookable areas (your courts) and read their availability before booking
- [Contacts API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/contacts.md): Search, open, create, update, and archive the customers your bookings belong to
- [Instructors API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/instructors.md): Find the coach leading a session and get the instructorId a booking needs
- [Classes API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/classes.md): List, create, update, and delete class occurrences, read a class roster, and book a customer into a class through the Platform API
- [Plans API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/plans.md): Find, create, update, retire, and delete membership plans
- [Memberships API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/memberships.md): Put a customer on a plan, then pause, resume, or cancel it
- [Products API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/products.md): Search, create, and update the products a gym sells over the counter, and read how many are left to sell
- [Bookings API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/bookings.md): Create, cancel, and look up bookings through the platform API
- [Check-ins API](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/checkins.md): List attendance records, and check in an existing booking or a member without one, through the Platform API
- [Idempotency](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/idempotency.md): Retry any write safely with an Idempotency-Key, so a timeout never becomes a duplicate booking
- [Webhooks](https://docs.1club.ai/api-reference/channel-integration/webhooks.md): Get notified when availability, contacts, memberships or charges change
- [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.1club.ai/openapi-platform.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3 description of every Platform API endpoint

## Changelog

- [Changelog](https://docs.1club.ai/changelog.md): New features and improvements in 1club

## Launches

The biggest releases, each told on a page of its own with screenshots.

- [Bookings and reviews from Google](https://docs.1club.ai/changelog/google-book-button.md): A Book button on your Google listing, and more Google reviews from your members. Launched November 10, 2026.
- [Review requests for every club](https://docs.1club.ai/changelog/review-request.md): Ask members to rate their visit the morning after, and invite them to review you on Google, on every plan. Launched November 4, 2026.
- [The new 1club App](https://docs.1club.ai/changelog/mobile-app-2.md): The 1club App 2.0 is out on iOS and Android, with a new design that puts your club first and gives members a reason to come back every week. Launched November 4, 2026.
- [1club in ChatGPT](https://docs.1club.ai/changelog/chatgpt-app.md): 1club Admin is now in ChatGPT. Run your business by asking about your schedule, members and sales in plain words. Launched October 29, 2026.
